g.text: Prompt emotion profiles and dominant-axis text highlights
System-only L14 · overlapping eight emotion axes at actual token positions · original Korean prompts
Right: largest within-axis z at each character, highlighted only above z = 0.5; darker = larger z (saturates at 2.5).
Across-six-prompt character calibration; overlapping byte-token fragments averaged. Descriptive, not emotion probability or causal activation.
